_about: SuVtitle - installer/models.json: THE list of the AI models SuVtitle installs in {app}\models (one entry per file).
The LIGHT installer (the default of installer/SuVtitle_Setup.iss) embeds none of them: at install time it downloads from
`url` every model that {app}\models lacks (or holds with another size), Inno Setup checks its `sha256`, and the file is
saved as `file`. The FULL installer (ISCC /DFull) embeds them, and refuses a bundle whose manifest has other bytes.
Every `url` is pinned to a COMMIT of the publisher's own Hugging Face repository, and the file at that commit is
byte-identical to ours: its Git LFS oid (the SHA-256 of the content, read from
https://huggingface.co/api/models/<repo>/tree/<commit>) equals `sha256`, and its size equals `size`. Never put another
quantization or another host here: find the byte-identical file, or keep the old entry.
After an edit: `node installer\gen_iss_registry.js --write` (rewrites the generated models block of the .iss), then
`node installer\gen_iss_registry.js --check`. deploy/make_bundle.js reads this file too (the models of a full bundle).
`license` is what the source page declares (checked 03/11/2026); `license_note` says what is not settled.

models.why: transcription (FILE quality auto / fast; the final model of the live quality preset)
LIVE transcription (the balanced preset, the draft of quality; a FILE job when turbo is absent)
LIVE transcription (the light preset, for a PC without a fast GPU; a FILE job when turbo is absent)

models.license_note: GGUF quantization by Unsloth of Qwen/Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 (Apache-2.0); both pages declare apache-2.0.

models.why: translation fallback (preset light; used when the 4B is absent)

models.license_note: ONNX build of the 3D-Speaker CAM++ model iic/speech_campplus_sv_zh_en_16k-common_advanced, whose ModelScope metadata declares Apache License 2.0; the Hugging Face repository of this ONNX build has no model card and states no license (THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md).
models.why: LIVE speaker model (CAM++ through sherpa-onnx): tells the voices on one strip apart
